notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes list America's Freedom Festival in Provo and a Freedom Festival contact. Gmail adds important history: Adventure Zone previously attended in 2021, and in late 2025 the festival said it does not pay vendors; vendors pay to participate. Preserve as prior-client/business-model context rather than treating this as an untouched lead. Source: handwritten call notes, page 67; Adventure Zone Gmail.
